name: Farmland
bpBasis: Sized by wheat at 100 kg an hour, 876 t a year, 241 ha at the FAO world wheat yield of 3.64 t a ha (2024, through Our World in Data); the World Bank AICD background paper (2008) takes $1,000 a ha to develop large-scale irrigation, so $241,000

name: Greenhouse
bpBasis: Sized by leafy greens at 300 kg an hour, 2,628 t a year; AeroFarms invested $42M in its Danville vertical farm (2019), which grows over 3 million lb, 1,361 t, of leafy greens a year, scaled linearly to $81M

biosphere.basis: A pressurised dome of 6,700 m3 for 100 people on the Moon, 67 m3 a person as NASA sizes a habitat for four crew on a 380-day mission (268 m3). It holds 300 times the body's suitability, half that under 0.1 g. The inflatable shell, 29 m across, weighs 406 t at the B330's 20 t for 330 m3, made of the inflatable habitat's materials scaled by mass; 17 life support units for six people each weigh 15 t; 3.34 m of local regolith over the dome, 8,500 t at 1.5 t a cubic metre, keeps the dose to 20 mSv a year at solar minimum. It draws 83 kW, the 3 kW of a life support unit and 2 kW of a habitat module for every six people. Nine workers maintain it: NASA Ames' Habot model gives about 1.2 crew-hours a resident a day for inspection and maintenance, 0.85 of them for the habitat's twelve of seventeen systems, over a working day of 9.5 hours

name: Algae bioreactor
bpBasis: Sized by spirulina at 1 t an hour, 8,760 t a year; Chalermthai et al. (Scientific Reports, 2023) cost a 20 ha raceway plant making about 1,000 t of spirulina powder and 1,200 t of bioplastic a year at $55.7M, scaled linearly by the spirulina to $488M; the bioplastic line makes it high

name: Protein fermenter
bpBasis: Sized by single-cell protein at 1 t an hour, 8,760 t a year; the Unibio methanotroph protein plant in Saudi Arabia is to make 50,000 t a year for about $373M (2026), scaled linearly to $65M

name: Food plant
bpBasis: Sized by rations at 1 t an hour, 8,760 t a year; Almunajem Foods built a 35,000 t a year food factory in Jeddah for $41.88M (2024), scaled linearly to $10.5M
